== Notes ==
* This skill will cause maximum health degeneration at rank 14 and above.
* The healing effect scales to be ~50% of the hex's maximum damage potential. For example, at rank 12, the skill will inflict a maximum of 216 damage, healing 113 points when it ends.
* You can increase the [[duration]] of the hex, increasing the net damage without affecting the amount of healing:
** Using [[Mantra of Persistence]].
** By re-applying the hex before it runs out. 
* Removing the hex early (e.g. via [[Cure Hex]]) will trigger the healing. Use a [[cover]] hex to prevent this.
* The healing caused by Illusion of Pain does not trigger [[Scourge Healing]].
* The [[AI]] only uses this skill on targets whose health is below two thirds of maximum.
